title: A Merry Munsch-mas! Family Holiday Show
summary: Kick off the holiday season for the whole family with a fun-filled and zany storytelling play featuring four treasured Robert Munsch tales: Sounds Like Christmas, Finding Christmas, I Have to Go! and Thomas’ Snowsuit. Performed by actor M. John Kennedy (Fireside Munsch) with warmth, humour and fun-filled audience engagement; perfect for all ages.
